k: A painted carousel beast. It goes round and round. It has never stopped.
src: 'A painted carousel beast. It goes round and round. It has never stopped.'

k: Birthday Mimic
src: 'Birthday Mimic'

k: A present nobody ever opened. It resents that.
src: 'A present nobody ever opened. It resents that.'

k: Kite Over Aurenne
src: 'Kite Over Aurenne'

k: The kite a boy flew on the last good afternoon. In the memory, it never comes down.
src: 'The kite a boy flew on the last good afternoon. In the memory, it never comes down.'

k: The First Bell
src: 'The First Bell'

k: The bell that should have rung one o'clock. It has been holding its breath ever since.
src: 'The bell that should have rung one o\'clock. It has been holding its breath ever since.'

k: The Painted Procession
src: 'The Painted Procession'

k: The festival's leading dancer, painted in noon. She has been mid-twirl for forty years and she is very tired.
src: 'The festival\'s leading dancer, painted in noon. She has been mid-twirl for forty years and she is very tired.'

k: Someone nobody remembers anymore. It is trying very hard to remember itself.
src: 'Someone nobody remembers anymore. It is trying very hard to remember itself.'

k: Gloam Tide
src: 'Gloam Tide'

k: The night the Lantern failed, the dark came up through the gutters like floodwater.
src: 'The night the Lantern failed, the dark came up through the gutters like floodwater.'

k: Watcher in the Spill
src: 'Watcher in the Spill'

k: The feeling of being looked at from the dark, given a shape.
src: 'The feeling of being looked at from the dark, given a shape.'

k: Hound of the Spill
src: 'Hound of the Spill'

k: It came up out of the gutters with the others. It is looking for a girl.
src: 'It came up out of the gutters with the others. It is looking for a girl.'

k: The Hungry Dark
src: 'The Hungry Dark'

k: The Gloam, the one night it came into Aurenne. It took one child. It has been hungry ever since.
src: 'The Gloam, the one night it came into Aurenne. It took one child. It has been hungry ever since.'

k: It sings Cassian's hymns. It does not know any others.
src: 'It sings Cassian\'s hymns. It does not know any others.'

k: Sunforged Knight
src: 'Sunforged Knight'

k: Plate forged from noon. Inside, nobody — only the idea of someone who would never let you get hurt.
src: 'Plate forged from noon. Inside, nobody — only the idea of someone who would never let you get hurt.'

k: Hour Watcher
src: 'Hour Watcher'

k: Tick. Tick. Tick. It is counting something. It will not say what.
src: 'Tick. Tick. Tick. It is counting something. It will not say what.'

k: Cassian, the Hierophant
src: 'Cassian, the Hierophant'

k: He has never once raised his voice. He is not raising it now.
src: 'He has never once raised his voice. He is not raising it now.'

k: Choir Shade
src: 'Choir Shade'

k: Acolytes he remembers. They remember nothing but the hymns.
src: 'Acolytes he remembers. They remember nothing but the hymns.'

k: The Noon King
src: 'The Noon King'

k: Cassian and the broken sun, sung into one shape. The king of a single afternoon.
src: 'Cassian and the broken sun, sung into one shape. The king of a single afternoon.'

k: One of the seven pieces. It circles the King like a moth around a— well.
src: 'One of the seven pieces. It circles the King like a moth around a— well.'

k: Vesper, the Unending Moment
src: 'Vesper, the Unending Moment'

k: The Vespersong, grown a face. A clock that ate the sun. It does not want anything except for this to never end.
src: 'The Vespersong, grown a face. A clock that ate the sun. It does not want anything except for this to never end.'

k: Hour Hand
src: 'Hour Hand'

k: Slow. Inevitable. It has been coming toward you since the moment you were born.
src: 'Slow. Inevitable. It has been coming toward you since the moment you were born.'

k: Minute Hand
src: 'Minute Hand'

k: Quick. Restless. Never where it was a moment ago.
src: 'Quick. Restless. Never where it was a moment ago.'

k: The string snaps taut. The kite stoops like a hawk!
src: 'The string snaps taut. The kite stoops like a hawk!'

k: The kite climbs into air that has not moved in forty years...
src: 'The kite climbs into air that has not moved in forty years...'

k: "Hush," says the Bell, in a voice like an empty cathedral.
src: '"Hush," says the Bell, in a voice like an empty cathedral.'

k: The First Bell swings back... and back... and back...
src: 'The First Bell swings back... and back... and back...'

k: Confetti swirls into the shape of a dancer!
src: 'Confetti swirls into the shape of a dancer!'

k: "And one-two-three, and one-two-three, and—"
src: '"And one-two-three, and one-two-three, and—"'

k: The dark opens. It has been hungry for a very long time.
src: 'The dark opens. It has been hungry for a very long time.'

k: Shadows peel off the Hungry Dark and run on four legs!
src: 'Shadows peel off the Hungry Dark and run on four legs!'

k: The Hungry Dark opens wider. It wants whoever is weakest.
src: 'The Hungry Dark opens wider. It wants whoever is weakest.'

k: "I don't want to hurt you, Wren. I never have. Please — let me show you."
src: '"I don\'t want to hurt you, Wren. I never have. Please — let me show you."'

k: "Sing with me, children. Just once more."
src: '"Sing with me, children. Just once more."'

k: Cassian hums the first bar of the Vespersong. The air forgets how to move.
src: 'Cassian hums the first bar of the Vespersong. The air forgets how to move.'

k: Cassian lifts his hands. The first verse of the Vespersong gathers in the air...
src: 'Cassian lifts his hands. The first verse of the Vespersong gathers in the air...'

k: "Look at it, Wren. The sun, whole — for as long as I can hold it."
src: '"Look at it, Wren. The sun, whole — for as long as I can hold it."'

k: The seven shards blaze into a crown of noon.
src: 'The seven shards blaze into a crown of noon.'

k: The shards are tearing loose! Light can reach the man inside the sun!
src: 'The shards are tearing loose! Light can reach the man inside the sun!'

k: A shard tears free and circles the King.
src: 'A shard tears free and circles the King.'

k: The King lifts the broken sun to its highest point...
src: 'The King lifts the broken sun to its highest point...'

k: The Hour and Minute Hands cross before Vesper's face. It is shielded!
src: 'The Hour and Minute Hands cross before Vesper\'s face. It is shielded!'

k: A hand falls still. Vesper's face is open!
src: 'A hand falls still. Vesper\'s face is open!'

k: Vesper, Unwound
src: 'Vesper, Unwound'

k: Vesper's hands spin backwards. Every clock in Evernoon begins to unwind — its weaknesses turn with it!
src: 'Vesper\'s hands spin backwards. Every clock in Evernoon begins to unwind — its weaknesses turn with it!'

k: Vesper, the Last Second
src: 'Vesper, the Last Second'

k: "STAY," says every clock at once. Vesper rewinds itself — but dawn-colored cracks are showing through!
src: '"STAY," says every clock at once. Vesper rewinds itself — but dawn-colored cracks are showing through!'

k: The last toll sounds. Someone's time is running out.
src: 'The last toll sounds. Someone\'s time is running out.'

k: A hand reassembles itself out of the ticking.
src: 'A hand reassembles itself out of the ticking.'

k: Both hands creep toward XII...
src: 'Both hands creep toward XII...'

k: Vesper begins to hum a lullaby. Stay. Stay. Stay...
src: 'Vesper begins to hum a lullaby. Stay. Stay. Stay...'

k: The clock-sun swells. It is about to strike noon forever...
src: 'The clock-sun swells. It is about to strike noon forever...'

k: Mott's Last Pack
src: 'Mott\'s Last Pack'

k: Bettany's Stall
src: 'Bettany\'s Stall'

k: Where Cassian's frozen afternoon stood. Only a quiet morning now, and two names on a stone.
src: 'Where Cassian\'s frozen afternoon stood. Only a quiet morning now, and two names on a stone.'

k: Merry's Acorn
src: 'Merry\'s Acorn'

k: A small acorn, warm as a held hand. "The key to my secret place."
src: 'A small acorn, warm as a held hand. "The key to my secret place."'

k: Thorne's Writ
src: 'Thorne\'s Writ'

k: "The girl is to be detained and conveyed to the Cathedral of Dawn. Unharmed." Sealed in black wax.
src: '"The girl is to be detained and conveyed to the Cathedral of Dawn. Unharmed." Sealed in black wax.'

k: MAG +4, RES +4, MP +10%. Inscribed inside: "Keep the light."
src: 'MAG +4, RES +4, MP +10%. Inscribed inside: "Keep the light."'

k: Pell's Horseshoe
src: 'Pell\'s Horseshoe'

k: LCK +10, DEF +4. The third horseshoe from over the Pell farmhouse door.
src: 'LCK +10, DEF +4. The third horseshoe from over the Pell farmhouse door.'

k: Cliff Kite
src: 'Cliff Kite'

k: Rides the Gale like a thrown knife. Nests in the cliffs and resents everyone below them.
src: 'Rides the Gale like a thrown knife. Nests in the cliffs and resents everyone below them.'

k: Rockshell
src: 'Rockshell'

k: A crab that took one look at the Gale and grew a boulder on its back.
src: 'A crab that took one look at the Gale and grew a boulder on its back.'

k: Spume Jelly
src: 'Spume Jelly'

k: Sea-foam that learned to hold a grudge. Spits salt in your eyes.
src: 'Sea-foam that learned to hold a grudge. Spits salt in your eyes.'

k: The Lord-Commander's personal guard. Black trim, a sun with a closed eye, and orders they will not explain.
src: 'The Lord-Commander\'s personal guard. Black trim, a sun with a closed eye, and orders they will not explain.'

k: Mourning Moth
src: 'Mourning Moth'

k: They drink tears. In the Whisperwold they never go thirsty.
src: 'They drink tears. In the Whisperwold they never go thirsty.'

k: Hollow Sapling
src: 'Hollow Sapling'

k: A young tree with a hollow where its heart should be. Something whispers in the hollow.
src: 'A young tree with a hollow where its heart should be. Something whispers in the hollow.'

k: Lost Shade
src: 'Lost Shade'

k: It is saying something. It has been saying it for a hundred years. It no longer knows to whom.
src: 'It is saying something. It has been saying it for a hundred years. It no longer knows to whom.'

k: The oldest tree in the Whisperwold. She gathered the voices of the dead into her hollow so that none of them would ever be forgotten — or ever be allowed to end.
src: 'The oldest tree in the Whisperwold. She gathered the voices of the dead into her hollow so that none of them would ever be forgotten — or ever be allowed to end.'

k: Three generations of Pells built him. One sack of cheap purple stuffing woke him up.
src: 'Three generations of Pells built him. One sack of cheap purple stuffing woke him up.'

k: Bandit Bruiser
src: 'Bandit Bruiser'

k: Red Tam hires by the pound.
src: 'Red Tam hires by the pound.'

k: Tam's Mastiff
src: 'Tam\'s Mastiff'

k: Answers to "Biscuit." Do not call it Biscuit.
src: 'Answers to "Biscuit." Do not call it Biscuit.'

k: Rubblekin
src: 'Rubblekin'
